Simulated Bifurcation documentation ↗

What is AI+?


Enhancements for Meta AI models


AI+ combines Meta AI models with Simulated Bifurcation running on NVIDIA GPUs through Modal to improve response times and solution quality in complex tasks.


  • AI understands your question and writes the answer. For supported optimization problems, it can ask the optimizer for help.
  • Simulated Bifurcation searches for good combinations of choices, such as assignments or balanced workloads. Two search variants are followed by a bounded, general local refinement; the original candidates remain available.
  • NVIDIA provides the classical GPU hardware that runs this optimization algorithm.
  • Modal starts and runs that GPU in the cloud when the optimizer is called.


The optimizer returns a candidate solution. Our application checks its numbers and constraints, and AI explains the result.


For ordinary questions, AI may answer without using the optimizer. The results show whether the tool actually ran.


This is quantum-inspired optimization on classical hardware. AI+ is a combination of tools, not a separately trained model. It is not guaranteed to be faster or more accurate.


AI+ API


Use AI+ from another application. Send a question or a numerical problem and receive a JSON answer with measured timings and optimizer usage.


Checking API configuration…


RequestWhat it does


POST /api/v1/solveRuns only AI+. Ordinary questions may not use the optimizer.


POST /api/v1/compareRuns AI alone and AI+ independently, like this website.


GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}Retrieves your job and its result. Poll every 2 seconds.


POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/cancelRequests cancellation. Work already submitted to a provider may still be billed.


POST /api/v1/media/compareCompare Muse Image generation and editing. Requires MODEL_API_KEY; see the OpenAPI schema.


GET /api/v1/info
GET /api/v1/examples		Reads configuration or examples without running a model.




Your API key: use AI_PLUS_API_KEY from this service's Render Environment settings. It is separate from your web password, Fireworks key and Modal credentials. Send it as Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY. Keep it on your application's server.


Submissions return 202 Accepted and a job ID. Reuse the same request_id when retrying the same submission while its job is retained. For comparisons, check each engine's status and validation; completion does not mean both answers succeeded.




Copy this script into PowerShell to call the deployed API. It asks for your key securely. Running it can consume Fireworks tokens and Modal GPU usage. Opening this guide or copying the script does not run either provider.

Limits and result format

One running job shared by the API and website. Each key can start 4 jobs per minute and 40 per rolling 24 hours; all API keys share 80 per 24 hours. Read limit: 90 requests per minute per key. Jobs time out after 400 seconds.


Results are kept in memory for at most one hour, with only the latest 20 jobs retained across all users. Redeploys/restarts erase jobs and reset counters. Export results promptly. These limits are not a billing cap.


For solve, read result.engine (answer or bits, usage and time), result.optimizer_used and result.gpu_execution_verified. For compare, read result.engines.meta, result.engines.assisted and result.comparison.


Text accuracy and the translation of a question into mathematics are not independently verified. Numerical inputs are limited to 64 binary decisions. Solve does not run an independent optimality search. Faster does not necessarily mean better.

What is AI+ for images?
Enhancements for Meta AI models
AI+ is an application workflow, not a separately trained model. Both paths use the same target model. Image generation/editing adds a Muse Spark 1.3 preparation call. Every call and preparation time is included. The original and prepared prompts are visible in the results.
Simulated Bifurcation, NVIDIA and Modal are used for numerical optimization in the task workspace. This media workflow does not invoke or verify a separate GPU optimizer. It does not guarantee a faster or better result.


Media data and verification
Times include request preparation, provider calls, transfer and image processing. Image quality is not automatically scored. A valid response is not proof that all requested objects or edits are correct.
Uploaded images are sent to AI when you press Compare. Results are held temporarily in this service's memory; only the latest three media jobs are retained, for up to one hour. Restarts erase them. Download the results promptly.
